## Preface

This is the data collection script for the SDM NN. I originally used the environmental data in AusAMF and two other datasets, but I don't think I have enough environmental information to calculate distributions.

So, we are starting from scratch here.

The assumed working directory is the jobs folder.

## Libraries
```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tidyterra)
```

## Alignment Function

```{r}
## Align rasters to the main template raster
align_raster = function(x, template, categorical = NULL,
                        filename = "", overwrite = TRUE) {
  aligned_layers = vector("list", nlyr(x))
  for (i in seq_len(nlyr(x))) {
    layer = x[[i]]

    # Determine whether this layer is categorical
    if (is.null(categorical)) {
      data_type = datatype(layer)
      is_categorical = grepl(
        "INT|LOG",
        data_type,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      is_categorical = categorical[i]
    }

    # Select resampling method
    method = if (is_categorical) "near" else "bilinear"

    cat(
      "Aligning layer", i, "of", nlyr(x),
      ":", names(layer),
      "- method:", method, "\n"
    )

    aligned_layers[[i]] = project(
      x = layer,
      y = template,
      method = method,
      use_gdal = TRUE
    )
  }

  # Combine aligned layers
  aligned = rast(aligned_layers)

  # Optionally write the result to disk
  if (filename != "") {
    aligned = writeRaster(
      aligned,
      filename,
      overwrite = overwrite,
      wopt = list(gdal = c("BIGTIFF=YES"))
    )
  }
  return(aligned)
}
```


## AusAMF
AusAMF datasets that are likely to overlap with other data sources are prefaced with `AA_`

```{r}
# load in abundance matrices, metadata, and taxonomy
abundance = read.csv("../raw_data/AusAMF/abundance_matrix.csv", row.names = 1)
AA_metadata = read.csv("../raw_data/AusAMF/sample_metadata.csv")
AA_filtering = read.csv("../raw_data/AusAMF/filtering_info.csv")
AA_taxonomy = read.csv("../raw_data/AusAMF/VT_taxonomy.csv")

# env_cube for environmental data from AusAMF
# input data for raster files is downloaded from the cited figshare in the manuscript
# https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28817378.v1
env_cube = rast("../raw_data/AusAMF/AusAMF_env_cube.tif")
env_cube = rename(env_cube, total_N = Total_N, avail_P = Avail_P, totalP = Total_P, elevation = Elevation, pH_cacl = pH) # this is just to keep names the same between the original metadata and that in the environmental cube. The mismatch is from the original paper.

# crop to match spatial extent of Australia
tocrop = terra::ext(112, 112+0.025*1681, -44, -44+0.025*1361)
env_cube = terra::crop(env_cube, tocrop)

# project data cube
AA_envcube = project(
  x = env_cube,
  y = "EPSG:3577",
  method = "bilinear",
  use_gdal = TRUE
)
```

## TERN
`TE_` prefixes. There is a lot of environmental raster data. So, let's combine into a raster data cube. Match extent of env_cube

```{r}
TE_files = list.files("../raw_data/tern/", full.names = TRUE)

# I confirmed the tern files are in the same crs as the env_cube the bounding box is based on.

# The maps are high resolution and large, so it's easy to crash the computer when cropping all layers at the same time. Here, we will do the cropping layer by layer in a loop.
TE_cube = vector("list", length(TE_files))

for (i in seq_along(TE_files)) {
  cat("Processing file", i, "of", length(TE_files), "\n")
  
  r = rast(TE_files[i])
  r_crop = terra::crop(r, tocrop)
  
  TE_cube[[i]] = r_crop
  
  # to save memory, we will remove the variables not in the data cube in the for loop
  rm(r, r_crop)
  gc()
}

# some of the grids are just slightly off in terms of extent, origin, and dimension. Like vvvvveeeeerrrrrryyyyy small differences. This creates an issue when trying to collapse them into a single data cube. The issue is in the quarterly NDVI measurements. We will resample those based on the first TE_cube layer
template = rast(TE_files[1])
NDVI_files = TE_files[11:14]
NDVI_aligned = vector("list", length(NDVI_files))

for (i in seq_along(NDVI_files)) {
  cat("Processing NDVI layer", i, "\n")

  r = rast(NDVI_files[i])

  # Align to reference grid
  r_aligned = terra::resample(
    r,
    template,
    method = "bilinear"
  )

  # Crop
  r_aligned = terra::crop(r_aligned, tocrop)

  NDVI_aligned[[i]] = r_aligned

  rm(r, r_aligned)
  gc()
}

# replace the misaligned NDVI files
TE_cube[11:14] = NDVI_aligned

# combine cropped layers into a data cube
TE_cube = rast(TE_cube)

# Check the raster before projecting
print(TE_cube)

# reproject TE_cube
TE_cube = align_raster(
  x = TE_cube,
  template = rast_template,
  filename = "../processed_data/TE_cube_projection.tif"
)
```

## Building single data cube for analyses

For use in neural network, we want to combine everything into a single data cube to simplify extraction of data and ensure consistency of pixels between layers.

```{r}
# for intermediate datasets
raster_dir = "../processed_data/rasters"

dir.create(
  raster_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# for final data cube
final_cube = "../processed_data/AMF_environmental_cube.tif"

## Verify main template

stopifnot(
  !is.na(crs(rast_template)),
  ncell(rast_template) > 0
)

cat("Master grid CRS:", crs(rast_template), "\n")
cat("Resolution:", res(rast_template), "\n")
cat("Dimensions:", dim(rast_template), "\n")
cat("Extent:", as.character(ext(rast_template)), "\n")
cat("Number of cells:", ncell(rast_template), "\n")
```

```{r}
## Prepare existing raster datasets

# Add dataset prefixes to layer names
names(AA_envcube) = paste0("AA_", names(AA_envcube))
names(FH_firemap) = paste0("FH_", names(FH_firemap))
names(TE_cube) = paste0("TE_", names(TE_cube))

# Check spatial alignment against the main template
stopifnot(
  compareGeom(AA_envcube, rast_template, stopOnError = FALSE),
  compareGeom(FH_firemap, rast_template, stopOnError = FALSE),
  compareGeom(TE_cube, rast_template, stopOnError = FALSE)
)

# Inspect layer names
cat("AusAMF layers:\n")
print(names(AA_envcube))

cat("Fire history layers:\n")
print(names(FH_firemap))

cat("TERN layers:\n")
print(names(TE_cube))

# Combine raster datasets
environmental_cube = c(
  AA_envcube,
  FH_firemap,
  TE_cube
)

# Write intermediate cube to disk
intermediate_cube = "../processed_data/environmental_cube_intermediate.tif"

# Remove if exists
file.remove(intermediate_cube)

writeRaster(
  environmental_cube,
  filename = intermediate_cube,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  wopt = list(
    gdal = c("BIGTIFF=YES", "COMPRESS=LZW"),
    datatype = "FLT4S"
  )
)

# Reload saved cube
environmental_cube = rast(intermediate_cube)

# Report output
print(environmental_cube)
cat("Saved intermediate cube:", intermediate_cube, "\n")

# Verify alignment
compareGeom(
  environmental_cube,
  rast_template,
  stopOnError = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
### Inspect NVIS vector to determine how to rasterize

# Inspect NVIS attribute fields
for (i in seq_along(NV_layers)) {
  cat("\n", NV_avail_layers$name[i], "\n")
  print(names(NV_layers[[i]]))
}

# Inspect NVIS categories
NV_categories = list()

for (layer_name in NV_avail_layers$name[1:8]) {

  cat("\nInspecting:", layer_name, "\n")

  # SPATIAL_MIX
  query_mix = paste0(
    "SELECT DISTINCT SPATIAL_MIX FROM ", layer_name
  )

  mix = st_read(
    dsn = gdb_path,
    query = query_mix,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  # NO_VEG_DESC
  query_noveg = paste0(
    "SELECT DISTINCT NO_VEG_DESC FROM ", layer_name
  )

  noveg = st_read(
    dsn = gdb_path,
    query = query_noveg,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  NV_categories[[layer_name]] = list(
    SPATIAL_MIX = st_drop_geometry(mix),
    NO_VEG_DESC = st_drop_geometry(noveg)
  )
}
```

```{r}
## Repeat above for IUCN data

IU_attributes = values(IU_protection)

# Number of polygons
nrow(IU_attributes)

# Missing values per field
colSums(is.na(IU_attributes))

IU_character_fields = names(IU_attributes)[
  sapply(IU_attributes, is.character)
]

sapply(
  IU_attributes[IU_character_fields],
  function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x)))
)

IU_lookup = list()

for (field in IU_character_fields) {

  categories = unique(
    IU_attributes[[field]][!is.na(IU_attributes[[field]])]
  )

  encoded_field = paste0("ID_", field)

  # Create integer-coded attribute
  IU_protection[[encoded_field]] = match(
    IU_attributes[[field]],
    categories
  )

  # Only create a lookup entry when values exist
  if (length(categories) > 0) {
    IU_lookup[[field]] = data.frame(
      attribute = field,
      code = seq_along(categories),
      value = categories
    )
  }
}

IU_lookup = do.call(rbind, IU_lookup)
rownames(IU_lookup) = NULL

IU_raster_fields = c(
  names(IU_attributes)[
    sapply(IU_attributes, is.numeric)
  ],
  paste0("ID_", IU_character_fields)
)

IU_raster_fields
length(IU_raster_fields)

IU_rasters = vector("list", length(IU_raster_fields))

for (i in seq_along(IU_raster_fields)) {

  field = IU_raster_fields[i]

  cat(
    "Rasterizing", i, "of", length(IU_raster_fields),
    ":", field, "\n"
  )

  IU_rasters[[i]] = rasterize(
    x = IU_protection,
    y = rast_template,
    field = field
  )

  names(IU_rasters[[i]]) = paste0("IU_", field)
}

IU_cube = rast(IU_rasters)

writeRaster(
  IU_cube,
  filename = "../processed_data/rasters/IU_cube.tif",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  wopt = list(gdal = c("BIGTIFF=YES", "COMPRESS=LZW"))
)

write.csv(
  IU_lookup,
  file = "../processed_data/rasters/IUCN_lookup.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
### NVIS conversion
## NVIS rasterization: all Australian state/territory layers

NV_output = "../processed_data/rasters/NV_cube.tif"
NV_lookup_output = "../processed_data/rasters/NVIS_lookup.csv"

## 1. Load and project all eight vector layers

NV_states = lapply(
  NV_avail_layers$name[1:8],
  function(layer_name) {

    cat("Loading:", layer_name, "\n")

    x = vect(
      gdb_path,
      layer = layer_name
    )

    project(
      x,
      rast_template
    )
  }
)

names(NV_states) = sub(
  "NVIS7_0_AUST_EXT_",
  "",
  NV_avail_layers$name[1:8]
)


## 2. Identify attribute fields

NV_attributes = lapply(
  NV_states,
  values
)

NV_fields = names(NV_attributes[[1]])

# Check that all state layers have the same fields
stopifnot(
  all(vapply(
    NV_attributes,
    function(x) setequal(names(x), NV_fields),
    logical(1)
  ))
)


## 3. Identify field types across all states

NV_character_fields = NV_fields[
  vapply(NV_attributes[[1]], is.character, logical(1))
]

NV_date_fields = NV_fields[
  vapply(
    NV_attributes[[1]],
    function(x) inherits(x, "Date") ||
      inherits(x, "POSIXt"),
    logical(1)
  )
]

NV_numeric_fields = NV_fields[
  vapply(NV_attributes[[1]], is.numeric, logical(1)) &
    !NV_fields %in% NV_date_fields
]

NV_logical_fields = NV_fields[
  vapply(NV_attributes[[1]], is.logical, logical(1))
]


## 4. Create global lookup tables and encode character fields

NV_lookup = list()

for (field in NV_character_fields) {

  cat("Encoding:", field, "\n")

  # Collect unique values across all states
  categories = unique(
    unlist(
      lapply(
        NV_attributes,
        function(x) x[[field]]
      ),
      use.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  categories = categories[!is.na(categories)]

  encoded_field = paste0("ID_", field)

  # Create one consistent encoding across all states
  for (state in names(NV_states)) {

    NV_states[[state]][[encoded_field]] = match(
      NV_attributes[[state]][[field]],
      categories
    )

  }

  if (length(categories) > 0) {

    NV_lookup[[field]] = data.frame(
      attribute = field,
      code = seq_along(categories),
      value = categories
    )

  }
}

NV_lookup = do.call(rbind, NV_lookup)
rownames(NV_lookup) = NULL


## 5. Convert date fields to numeric days since 1970

# for (field in NV_date_fields) {
# 
#   cat("Converting date:", field, "\n")
# 
#   for (state in names(NV_states)) {
# 
#     NV_states[[state]][[paste0(field, "_days")]] =
#       as.numeric(as.Date(NV_attributes[[state]][[field]]))
# 
#   }
# 
# }


## 6. Convert logical fields to integers

for (field in NV_logical_fields) {

  for (state in names(NV_states)) {

    NV_states[[state]][[field]] = as.integer(
      NV_attributes[[state]][[field]]
    )

  }

}


## 7. Assemble raster field list

NV_raster_fields = c(
  NV_numeric_fields,
  NV_logical_fields,
  paste0("ID_", NV_character_fields)
)

cat(
  "Total attributes to rasterize:",
  length(NV_raster_fields),
  "\n"
)


## 8. Rasterize all attributes for each state

NV_rasters = list()

for (state in names(NV_states)) {

  cat("\nProcessing state:", state, "\n")

  NV_rasters[[state]] = vector(
    "list",
    length(NV_raster_fields)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(NV_raster_fields)) {

    field = NV_raster_fields[i]

    cat(
      "Rasterizing", i, "of", length(NV_raster_fields),
      ":", field, "\n"
    )

    NV_rasters[[state]][[i]] = rasterize(
      x = NV_states[[state]],
      y = rast_template,
      field = field
    )

    names(NV_rasters[[state]][[i]]) =
      paste0("NV_", state, "_", field)

  }

  NV_rasters[[state]] = rast(NV_rasters[[state]])

}


## 9. Combine all state raster cubes

NV_cube = rast(
  unlist(NV_rasters, recursive = FALSE)
)

print(NV_cube)


## 10. Verify alignment

stopifnot(
  compareGeom(
    NV_cube,
    rast_template,
    stopOnError = FALSE
  )
)


## 11. Save raster cube

writeRaster(
  NV_cube,
  filename = NV_output,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  wopt = list(
    gdal = c("BIGTIFF=YES", "COMPRESS=LZW")
  )
)


## 12. Save lookup table

write.csv(
  NV_lookup,
  file = NV_lookup_output,
  row.names = FALSE
)


## 13. Confirm output

cat("NVIS raster cube saved:", NV_output, "\n")
cat("NVIS lookup table saved:", NV_lookup_output, "\n")

print(NV_cube)
print(file.info(NV_output)$size / 1024^2)


## 14. Clear temporary objects

rm(
  NV_states,
  NV_attributes,
  NV_rasters,
  NV_cube
)

gc()
```

# Starting up again after NVIS projections

Reload libraries and temp folders for terra.
## Libraries
```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tidyterra)
```

## Projection Paths
```{r}
#Rorqual does not have internet access on the node I need, so I saved the tif grid for conversion to CRS 3577
local_grid = file.path("/home/herna499/links/projects/def-jstinchc/herna499/proj_data")

Sys.setenv(PROJ_DATA = local_grid)
Sys.setenv(PROJ_LIB  = local_grid)
Sys.setenv(PROJ_NETWORK = "OFF")
Sys.setenv(GDAL_HTTP_MAX_RETRY = "0")

message("PROJ Search Paths: ", paste(sf_proj_search_paths(), collapse = ", "))

sf_proj_network(enable = FALSE)
```

## terra options

```{r}
# potential work around for R crashing. It shouldn't be a memory issue, but just in case, let's let terra use a temp directory and override the default terra limits by using BIGTIFF=YES.

# Set temporary directory
terra_tmp = "../processed_data/terra_temp"

dir.create(
  terra_tmp,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

terraOptions(
  tempdir = terra_tmp,
  memfrac = 0.5,
  progress = 1
)
```

## Load intermediate raster cubes

```{r}
environmental_cube = rast(
  "../processed_data/environmental_cube_intermediate.tif"
)

IB_cube = rast(
  "../processed_data/rasters/IB_cube.tif"
)

IU_cube = rast(
  "../processed_data/rasters/IU_cube.tif"
)

SA_cube = rast(
  "../processed_data/rasters/SA_cube.tif"
)

NV_cube = rast(
  "../processed_data/rasters/NV_cube.tif"
)


## Inspect dimensions and layer counts

lapply(
  list(
    environmental = environmental_cube,
    IBRA = IB_cube,
    IUCN = IU_cube,
    soil_age = SA_cube,
    NVIS = NV_cube
  ),
  function(x) {
    list(
      dimensions = dim(x),
      layers = nlyr(x),
      names = names(x),
      resolution = res(x),
      extent = ext(x),
      CRS = crs(x)
    )
  }
)
```

## Verify alignment of geometries

```{r}
geometry_check = c(
  IBRA = compareGeom(

  ),

    environmental_cube, IU_cube,
    stopOnError = FALSE
  ),

    environmental_cube, SA_cube,
    stopOnError = FALSE
  ),
  NVIS = compareGeom(
    environmental_cube, NV_cube,
    stopOnError = FALSE
  )
)

print(geometry_check)
```
